summary: PR 7375 restored abbreviated telemetryIdPrefix values on 40 scaffolded metadata-only modules. It merged without recorded reviews.
proposed: The scaffolding in #7366 had derived fully hyphenated prefixes from module paths instead of the existing abbreviated convention, which would cause a telemetryIdPrefix diff in the next Module Metadata Catalog Sync run in the tools repo.
changed: Prefixes were reset to the historic abbreviated values from the AVM catalog CSVs, for example 46d3xbcp.ptn.ai-ml-landing-zone became 46d3xbcp.ptn.aiml-lz. The PR body says none of the modules has published Bicep code, so shipped telemetry is unchanged.
shipped: Updated telemetryIdPrefix values in the metadata of the 40 scaffold modules merged in one commit.
